sloka: ततः पितामहं दृष्ट्वा वायुः पुत्रवधार्दितः ।शिशुकं तं समादाय उत्तस्थौ धातुरग्रतः ।। ७.३६.१ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ pitāmahaṁ dṛṣṭvā vāyuḥ putravadhārditaḥ ।śiśukaṁ taṁ samādāya uttasthau dhāturagrataḥ ।। 7.36.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, Vayu, distressed by the injury to his son, having seen the grandfather Brahma, picked up that child and stood up in front of the creator.
